title: Grade 3 Character & Citizenship: Singapore CCE
description: Core values: Respect, Responsibility, Resilience, Integrity, Care & Harmony.

items.prompt: You accidentally spilled water on your classmate's drawing project. What is the most responsible response?

options.text: Blame a classmate walking past the desk
Pretend you did not notice the spill
Say sorry and help dry the drawing
Leave the room before anyone can see

items.explanation: Saying sorry and helping to fix the damage shows responsibility.

items.prompt: Your team is losing a sports match at school. What is the resilient attitude to adopt?

options.text: Cheer your team and keep trying
Walk off the court and give up
Argue with the referee at once
Blame the goalie for every goal

items.explanation: Resilience means staying kind and trying your best even when behind.

items.prompt: How can students practice racial and cultural harmony in a diverse school community?

options.text: Sit only with friends from one group
Make fun of another group's food
Skip every school cultural event
Respect every group's festivals and food

items.explanation: Harmony means respecting the languages, food, and festivals of others.

items.prompt: What does integrity mean when taking an independent quiz in class?

options.text: Share answers with a nearby friend
Do your own work without peeking
Look at notes hidden in a case
Change your score before showing it

items.explanation: Integrity means doing honest work even when no one is watching.

items.prompt: How can you show environmental care in the school canteen?

options.text: Leave wrappers on the dining table
Throw cans into the garden bushes
Return trays and wipe leftover crumbs
Take extra food and then waste it

items.explanation: Returning trays and cleaning crumbs keeps shared spaces clean.

items.prompt: A friend shares a personal secret with you and asks you to keep it safe. What should you do?

options.text: Post the secret for others to see
Tell the secret to friends at recess
Use the secret to tease your friend
Keep the secret unless they need help

items.explanation: Keeping a safe secret shows trust. Tell an adult if a friend is in danger.

items.prompt: What is the best way to resolve a disagreement with a classmate during group work?

options.text: Listen first and then find a fair plan
Shout louder until they agree with you
Refuse to do any of the group work
Call them names until they give in

items.explanation: Listening and looking for a fair plan solves group disagreements.

items.prompt: How can an older student be a positive role model to younger primary school students?

options.text: Tell younger children they cannot play
Follow school rules and offer kind help
Break small rules to look more cool
Ignore prefects and skip the lineup

items.explanation: Younger students copy older students who are kind and follow rules.

items.prompt: When you receive your pocket money allowance, what is a sound financial habit to practice?

options.text: Spend it all at once on sweets
Borrow more money from classmates
Save some first, then spend the rest
Hide it under a rug and forget it

items.explanation: Saving a portion first is a prudent money habit.

items.prompt: Why is gratitude an important personal value to cultivate?

options.text: It makes us proud and boastful
It lets us demand more presents
It is only useful on birthdays
It helps us thank family and teachers

items.explanation: Gratitude helps us notice and thank the people who care for us.
